waht is an Agentic AI system ?

An Agentic AI system refers to a type of artificial intelligence that has autonomy and self-awareness. It can make decisions independently, act upon them, and adapt to changing situations without explicit human intervention. In essence, agentic AI systems are capable of taking actions that align with their own goals or objectives.
